input.interpretation: This is a falsifiable schedule-specific test. Passing mathematical evidence would support H1 at the model scope but would not itself establish independent task acceptance. input.weakening_observation: Any reported metric exceeds its frozen limit, or numerical failure prevents complete-horizon evaluation; such a result weakens this schedule-specific hypothesis but does not establish global infeasibility of the structure or task.
